text: 科技股力撑美股指反弹，纳指涨超1%，芯片指数大涨，美光市值重回万亿美元；日元跌破163关口；贵金属上涨，白银涨超4%。 特朗普：伊朗想会谈但美国“没兴趣”，“很快”重击镐山核设施，警告胡塞武装勿封红海。 美国贸易代表暗示将很快出台新关税政策。 美财长贝森特宣称：美国很快将控制全球80%的算力。 日元创40年新低，美元兑日元涨破163，日当局干预的风险增大。 中国证监会周一和周二与上市公司等召开座谈会，就促进资本市场稳定 健康发展听取意见。证监会称将主动回应市场关切、增强市场内在稳定性。 量化私募业绩遭遇集体回撤，“量化砸盘”争议再起。 113家私募打新长
text_en: Tech stocks boosted US stock rebound, Nasdaq up over 1%, chip index surged, Micron's market cap back above $1 trillion; Yen broke below 163; Precious metals rose, silver up over 4%. Trump: Iran wants talks but US 'not interested', will 'soon' strike Natanz nuclear facility, warned Houthis not to block Red Sea. US Trade Representative hinted at new tariff policies soon. US Treasury Secretary Bessent claimed US will soon control 80% of global computing power. Yen hit 40-year low, USD/JPY broke above 163, increasing risk of Japanese intervention. China Securities Regulatory Commission held symposiums with listed companies on Monday and Tuesday to seek opinions on promoting stable and healthy capital market development. CSRC said it will actively respond to market concerns and enhance market stability. Quantitative private funds faced collective performance declines, reigniting 'quantitative selling' controversy. 113 private funds participated in IPO subscription.
